<action>perform_cross_validation</action>
<action_input>{
  "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_sulphides_trial_13/train.csv",
  "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
